business_overview.one_sentence: Weibo operates a China social media platform and earns mainly from advertising and marketing services, with a smaller value-added services business.

business_overview.revenue_model: Online advertising and promoted marketing products are the core revenue source; value-added services include platform and content-related services.
business_notes: Most operations and revenues are in China and a substantial portion is conducted through PRC VIE structures.

Annual report states consolidated affiliated entities in mainland China held US$2.0285 billion of cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments at 2025 year-end, including US$836.9 million held by VIEs and VIE subsidiaries.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Operating cash flow exceeded parent net profit in each of 2023-2025, and capex was modest versus operating cash flow. However, reported net profit includes investment gains and interest income from funds assets; the owner earnback denominator uses after-tax operating profit and applies a business/cash conversion haircut.

evidence.source: Annual Report 2025, consolidated statements of cash flows, F-8

gaps: Annual report does not split cash and short-term investments by legal entity and product type simultaneously; haircut allocation uses disclosed location split as the controlling constraint.
No precise restricted cash line was identified in the 2025 balance sheet; VIE/non-distributable reserve constraints are handled through haircut and operating cash reserve.
Maintenance versus growth capex is not separately disclosed; 2025 capex is used as a conservative maintenance proxy for this asset-light internet platform.
